# telnyx_pricing_product (Data Source)

The prices of one Telnyx product.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug.

### Optional

- `filter_country_iso` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `pricing_product` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing_product))

<a id="nestedatt--pricing_product"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pricing_product`

Read-Only:

- `cached_input_rate` (String) Cached input token rate. Present only on inference product entries.
- `cached_input_tiers` (Attributes List) Cached input token tiered pricing. Present only on inference product entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing_product--cached_input_tiers))
- `country_iso` (String) ISO country code. Null for non-geographic products.
- `currency` (String) ISO currency code (e.g., USD).
- `direction` (String) Direction (e.g., termination). Null for non-directional products.
- `input_rate` (String) Input token rate. Present only on inference product entries.
- `input_tiers` (Attributes List) Input token tiered pricing. Present only on inference product entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing_product--input_tiers))
- `model` (String) Model identifier. Present only on inference product entries.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name describing the pricing entry.
- `note` (String) Additional note for rate-deck products (e.g., "Pricing is determined by the WhatsApp rate deck.").
- `output_rate` (String) Output token rate. Present only on inference product entries.
- `output_tiers` (Attributes List) Output token tiered pricing. Present only on inference product entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing_product--output_tiers))
- `pricing_type` (String) Pricing type for non-standard products (e.g., rate_deck). Absent on standard products.
- `rate` (String) Per-unit rate. Numeric for standard products, string for inference products. Null for rate-deck products. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Volume-based tiered pricing. Empty for rate-deck products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing_product--tiers))
- `type` (String) Pricing type (e.g., usage).
- `unit` (String) Unit of measurement (e.g., part, message, GB, per_1k_tokens).

<a id="nestedatt--pricing_product--cached_input_tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pricing_product.cached_input_tiers`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) Upper bound of the tier (exclusive). Null means no upper limit.
- `min` (Number) Lower bound of the tier (inclusive).
- `rate` (String) Rate for this tier. Numeric for standard products, string for inference products. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
